text:
Ben (Sales): Passing the sales baton for Apex Health (Enterprise) — signed yesterday.
Ben (Sales): Topline: Private deployment (VPC), Okta SSO, dedicated capacity estimate: 2x A100-ish, billing monthly, initial SLA ask: 99.9%.
Ben (Sales): Known risks: security questionnaire still open, customer expects full data residency in us-east-1 before go-live, renewal governed by usage after 12 months (they flagged cost sensitivity).
Ben (Sales): Account info:
Ben (Sales): ```
account_id: APEX-00421
contract_term: 12m
go_live_target: 2025-02-12
initial_commit: 3M tokens/mo
notes: private-deploy requested, SSO + SCIM
```
Ava (CS): Thanks — picking this up. I'll be primary CS owner. Immediate goals: confirm VPC networking pre-reqs, schedule SSO test window, and run a preflight infra checklist with eng/support.
Maggie (CS Manager): @Ava (CS) please add the onboarding runbook and owners to the account doc and tag me for weekly check-ins for the first 8 weeks.
Ava (CS): Will do. Proposed owners: @Carlos (Support Eng) — infra/provisioning, @Priya (Eng) — private deploy packaging and ops config, me for enablement and success metrics.
Carlos (Support Eng): Acknowledge. Need the customer's VPC peering CIDR and network contact. Also will set up a temporary debugging VPN if they want an on-prem access window.
Priya (Eng): I'll sizes the dedicated pool and prepare a deployment image. ETA for a staging image: 3 business days after network info is in.
Ava (CS): Onboarding steps (short):
Ava (CS): 1) Collect VPC peering info + security contact
Ava (CS): 2) Provision isolated dev staging (Priya)
Ava (CS): 3) Okta SSO test + SCIM sync (Ava + Customer)
Ava (CS): 4) Pilot run, capture latency and token costs (Carlos)
Ava (CS): 5) Enablement session with product + playbooks (Ava)
ops-bot: provisioning task created: https://tasks.redwood.internal/PROV-789
Carlos (Support Eng): Created PROV-789. Assigned to @Carlos. ETA initial infra smoke: 48h.
Ben (Sales): Customer asked for an enablement session week of 2025-02-17. Can we lock that after staging is up?
Ava (CS): Yes — I'll tentatively book a 60min enablement slot and share agenda. We should include a short feedback capture form for the pilot (2–3 questions on latency, accuracy, integration friction).
Maggie (CS Manager): FYI renewal risk: flag as 'monitor' until security questionnaire closed. If questionnaire isn't closed within 30 days of go-live, escalate to renewals lead.
Ava (CS): Noted. I'll update the risk tag and ping @Ben (Sales) for escalation if needed.
Priya (Eng): One ask: do we want quantization/quantized model for cost? If they are cost-sensitive, I can prepare a quantized variant and run a quick perf/cost comparison in staging.
Ben (Sales): Yes please — customer expects cost options. Thanks.
Ava (CS): Next steps owner list I'll post in Confluence and tag the ticket. Meeting: scheduling invite in 24h. Closing loop here — thanks team :raised_hands:
Carlos (Support Eng): 👍
Priya (Eng): 👍
Ben (Sales): Thanks everyone.
Maggie (CS Manager): Thanks — keep me posted on the questionnaire.
